description: This is a Java Spring Boot REST controller class for managing Car entities, providing endpoints for CRUD operations.

classes.name: CarController
classes.description: REST controller handling HTTP requests for Car entities, including create, read, update, and delete operations.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new Car object.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all Car records.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a Car by its ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing Car by ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a Car by ID.
